thread:
alex_fin: FYI vendor 'ScandiParts' sent invoice SP-2101. Invoice shows VAT ID SE12345678 but customs copy uses EORI GB777666555. There's a short note: 'import VAT grossed up and included' — can AP pay this?

marta_vat: EORI != VAT ID. Need clarity on which legal entity invoiced. If the seller is Swedish (SE), export rules may apply and VAT should be 0% if goods exported from SE. If the UK branch imported and paid import VAT, invoice must show GB VAT or explicit reimbursement.

lee_ops: Goods were shipped from our UK fulfilment address per vendor track. They probably used their UK logistics arm for import.

jamie_ap: Holding payment. What's the minimal documentation to accept a gross-up?

marta_vat: Ask for: (1) corrected invoice specifying invoicing entity and VAT number with country prefix; (2) separate line for 'Import VAT reimbursement' with amount; (3) customs entry showing EORI used; (4) VAT registration cert for invoicing entity.

pat_legal: Also request a one-line statement in vendor email that the reimbursed amount is import VAT only and no further customs penalties will be claimed. Keeps liability clear.

alex_fin: I'll message vendor with those asks. Billing-bot please set invoice SP-2101 to HOLD.

billing-bot: Invoice SP-2101 status updated to HOLD by alex_fin  reason: tax clarification required.

lee_ops: Vendor replied next day: reissued SP-2101_rev1.pdf showing GB VAT GB777666555 and line: 'Import VAT reimbursed: EUR 48.00'. Attached customs entry and UK VAT cert.

jamie_ap: Quick checklist: invoice matches PO, bank details unchanged, separate gross-up line present, attachments OK.

marta_vat: Documentation sufficient. Reimbursement is documented; code to use import_vat_reimbursements ledger and retain customs entry. No reclaim on our VAT return.

pat_legal: They included a short indemnity in their email. Acceptable. If this repeats suggest adding standard clause to supplier T&Cs.

jamie_ap: Payment queued. Marking as PAID in system.

alex_fin: Closing thread. Thanks all :thumbsup:
